serviceOutput: Practical Personal Graph Modeling: Connecting concepts, authors, projects, and citations cleanly without over-engineered schemas.
Hybrid Graph-RAG Querying: Combining text search with graph relationships to answer multi-step research questions accurately.
Token Savings for AI Tools: Retrieving only the exact connected facts and citations instead of stuffing huge raw files into prompts.
Long-Term Research Recall: Maintaining a portable local graph in SQLite or NetworkX that grows smarter with every book or paper you read.
